test_title: PYST 3: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Mehar drives 19 km East from his home. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He again takes a left turn and drives 19 km. How far is he from starting point in a straight line?
solution:
Given: 

Mehar drives 19 km East from his home.

He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km.

He again takes a left turn and drives 19 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9cd6d0db2698e0a2b71a22fe9cb577aee24c4c38df5de0288b49c3987ef4008b.png] 

So, he is **11 km** from the starting point in a straight line.
